name: Deep Research Bench
description: A benchmark consisting of 89 multi-step web research task instances across 8 diverse categories, designed to evaluate the quality of AI web research agents using a frozen web page dataset and automated evaluation of agent traces.
reputation: A new research benchmark from the paper, with limited but growing visibility in the web-agent evaluation community.
notes: Includes a public leaderboard and evaluates hallucinations, tool use, and forgetting in web research agents.
